title: Docs assistant
description: Questions arrive through an API, a function retrieves passages from the indexed documents and asks a model to answer. Documents are loaded through a queue.

detail.role: Accepts chat requests over HTTPS and hands each to the chat function.
detail.why: One public entry point keeps authentication and throttling in a single place.

detail.role: Looks up the session, retrieves passages for the question and asks the model for an answer.
detail.why: Stateless, so it scales with requests and holds no data between calls.

detail.role: Finds the passages most related to a question.
detail.why: Answers are grounded in the company's own documents, not the model's memory.

api-chat>fn-chat.detail: Each request is passed to the chat function with the caller's session id.

detail.why: Not managed by Terraform, so it is drawn from the overlay.

detail.role: Writes the answer from the question and the retrieved passages.
detail.why: Called by model id, not created by this Terraform.

addLinks.label: Question
addLinks.detail: The widget sends the question and session id.

addLinks.label: Generate
addLinks.detail: The function sends the question with the retrieved passages and gets the answer back.

trace.label: The vector index returns the best matches
